bottleneck_localization.conclusion: The first real segmented capture localizes the runtime bottleneck to model inference, not saved LeRobot preprocessing or postprocessing.

interpretation: Compile and first-inference latency are cold-path values and are excluded from steady-state percentiles.
System available memory increased slightly during the short run, so it is treated as operating-system noise rather than negative memory use.
A three-degree CPU package rise is an observation from a short run, not thermal-stability evidence.
Independent stage percentile sums are diagnostic and are not a measured end-to-end distribution.
learning_step: Human operator executed the first formal segmented benchmark; independent explanation check remains pending.
decision: CPU FP32 measurement gate passes; repeated device measurements may move to agent-heavy execution.
